# Collection session API endpoint
{: .no_toc}



## Table of contents
{: .no_toc .text-delta }

1. TOC
{:toc}

## Endpoints

- **Private portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/collectionsession/` (needs a token; one record: append `<id>/`)
- **Public portal:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/public/stem/collectionsession/` (read-only, public projects, no token)
- **Response keys:** `collection_session` (detail, create, update), `collection_sessions` (list)
- **Permissions:** see the [permissions page](/datamodel/permissions/)
- **Uniqueness:** `collection`, `session` unique together

## Fields

**[required]** fields must be sent on create; **[read-only]** fields are returned but cannot be set. A *nestable* relation can be traversed in filters (`filter{field.other}`) and sideloaded with `include[]=field.*`; other relations can only be compared with ids (`filter{field}=<id>`). See the [query syntax](/api/#query-parameters).

| Field | Description |
|:------|:------------|
| `id` | number **[read-only]** |
| `session_name` | computed **[read-only]** |
| `session` | [`session`](/api/stem/session/) id **[required]** |
| `collection` | [`collection`](/api/stem/collection/) id **[required]** |
| `order` | number; nullable |

## List
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/collectionsession/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `401` Not authenticated; `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('collectionsession', load_all=True)
records = resp['collection_sessions']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
resp = client.load('collectionsession', 'load_all', true);
records = resp.collection_sessions;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "collection_sessions": [
        {
            "id": 1,
            "session_name": null,
            "session": "<session-id>",
            "collection": "<collection-id>",
            "order": 1
        }
    ],
    "meta": {
        "page": 1,
        "per_page": 100,
        "total_results": 1,
        "total_pages": 1
    }
}
```

## Add
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** POST
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/collectionsession/`
- **Data:** JSON object with at least the required fields
- **Responses:** `201` Created; `400` Bad request (validation errors per field); `403` Not allowed

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('collectionsession', data={"session": "<session-id>", "collection": "<collection-id>"})
record = resp.json()['collection_session']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
created = client.save(struct('session', '<session-id>', 'collection', '<collection-id>'), 'collectionsession');
record = created.collection_session;
```

## Detail
- **Allowed portals:** private, public
- **Request method:** GET
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/collectionsession/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.load('collectionsession', id='<id>')
record = resp.json()['collection_session']
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
out = client.load('collectionsession', 'id', '<id>');
record = out.collection_session;
```

### Response example
{: .no_toc}

```json
{
    "collection_session": {
        "id": 1,
        "session_name": null,
        "session": "<session-id>",
        "collection": "<collection-id>",
        "order": 1
    }
}
```

## Change
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** PATCH
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/collectionsession/<id>/`
- **Data:** JSON object with the fields to change. Lists (`projects`, `tags`, ...) and JSON payloads (`details`, coordinates) are replaced as a whole: read the record first and send the full list or object.
- **Responses:** `200` OK; `400` Bad request; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.save('collectionsession', id='<id>', data={"order": 1})
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.save(struct('id', '<id>', 'order', 1), 'collectionsession', 'method', 'patch');
```

## Delete
- **Allowed portals:** private
- **Request method:** DELETE
- **URL:** `https://www.brainstem.org/api/private/stem/collectionsession/<id>/`
- **Responses:** `204` Deleted; `400` Still referenced by other records; `403` Not allowed; `404` Not found

### Use example (Python API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```python
resp = client.delete('collectionsession', id='<id>')
```

### Use example (MATLAB API tool)
{: .no_toc}

```matlab
client.delete('<id>', 'collectionsession');
```
